moments.action: A commuter train slides past in near darkness, then the view pulls back to palms and a rainbow over the tracks as the lit train runs under it - night gives way to a bright wet day.
A pot of pork-and-greens soup boils; the camera finds the cramped kitchen where Amah sits with her back to us and M, plate in hand, spoons food out for her.

Chores in close-up: a charcoal stove lit beside bare crouched legs, hands pulling pandan leaves from a pot plant, the knotted leaves dropped into a pan of rice water. By the last shot Amah has come to the doorway to watch M stir.

A long held wide of the kitchen: Amah seated in the foreground, M behind her stirring a steaming pot, glancing over at her. It cuts back outside past his stirring hands to Amah, who now steps forward out of the doorway towards him.
An empty alley at night, wet underfoot, shuttered gates and potted plants lit by a single lamp - time has jumped to evening.

High wide of the night kitchen: Amah works at a green-topped table while M stands over her. Closer in, he leans on the table talking as she presses something into a blue basket; by the end he has broken into a grin.
